key.name: profiles-json
key.description: JSON array storing the configured folder mirror profiles.

key.name: global-excludes-json
key.description: JSON array storing the default exclude rules applied to new profiles.

key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Whether the Folder Mirror top-bar indicator is visible.

key.name: show-notifications
key.description: Whether manual runs and helper errors can trigger GNOME Shell notifications.

key.name: auto-start-helper
key.description: Whether the helper should automatically schedule watch-mode and run-at-login profiles.

key.name: watch-interval-seconds
key.description: Fallback polling interval used by the helper watch scheduler.

key.name: log-level
key.description: Logging verbosity used by the background helper.
